messages:
devon: quick one  saw a tenant flip to fallback twice during a retry storm, need better burst protection.

leila: product rule: quota spikes should create a "probe" state by default, not an immediate full fallback.

sam: runtime can do probe vs apply. probe emits minimal audit with `probe_id`, `trigger`, `sample_rate`. Full apply includes `policy_snapshot`.

charlie: ops wants numeric rules: require 3/5 windows breach OR a sustained 90s breach before promote. add cooldown 30s post-change.

gloria: UX: show "probe (quota)" chip with tiny sparkline; open drawer shows probe_id, sample_coverage, and a one-line "why" explanation. include "promote" and "pause" CTAs.

devon: retention: keep full traces for 14d, probe metadata and policy snapshots for 180d. allow on-demand export if legal holds.

sam: audit example (single-line): {"type":"probe","probe_id":"p-42","trigger":"quota","route":"/v1/chat","sample_rate":0.005} will be emitted to logs.

charlie: add a min_volume guard (default 50 reqs/window) so tiny tenants don't trigger quota probes. make it tenant-configurable.

leila: product: operator actions must be immutable with who/timestamp and a replay token for simulator.

devon: actions: @sam add probe/fallback events + min_volume guard; @charlie cost/retention estimate + cooldown defaults; @gloria prototype chip/drawer; @leila spec operator-audit + replay token. 30m sync tomorrow.

opsbot: ci/rollouts/canary  canary healthy on 3 routes.
